title: After School
text:
Maya is fifteen years old. Every day after school, she goes to the library with her friends. They study for two hours and then they walk home together. Maya likes the library because it is quiet and warm.

On Friday, Maya does not go to the library. She has a piano lesson at five o'clock. Her teacher says she is getting better every week. Maya practices for thirty minutes every night.

questions.text: Where does Maya go after school every day?
What does Maya do on Friday?
Why does Maya probably like the library?
options: It is far from her home.
It is open only on Fridays.

questions.text: What can we infer about Maya's piano skills?
options: She has stopped playing the piano.
She is improving at the piano.

vocabulary.definition: having a fairly high temperature, pleasant to feel
a period of time when someone is taught a subject or skill
does an activity regularly in order to get better at it

paragraph_translations: Майї п'ятнадцять років. Щодня після школи вона ходить до бібліотеки з друзями. Вони займаються дві години, а потім разом ідуть додому. Майї подобається бібліотека, бо там тихо і тепло.
У п'ятницю Майя не йде до бібліотеки. О п'ятій годині в неї урок гри на піаніно. Її вчителька каже, що вона з кожним тижнем грає краще. Майя займається щовечора по тридцять хвилин.
